finding.benchmark_invariant: NO_POST_BOUND_OLD_AUDIO: after the measured bounded in-flight tail, monitor readback contains no continuing old-packet source-correlated audio.
finding.defect: The analyzer computes post_bound_observed only from correlation windows whose source_start_ms is >= bound_end_ms, while BOUNDED_TAIL accepts observed_tail_ms <= max_inflight_ms + window_ms. A correlation window that starts just before the declared bound and ends after it is therefore excluded from the post-bound set and may extend old-audio attribution by up to one analysis window beyond the declared bound while the terminal predicate still passes.
finding.why_not_product_negative_yet: The current windowed measurement cannot distinguish whether a straddling correlated window contains old audio only before the bound or also after it. That boundary ambiguity is an evidence-resolution problem. It must not be silently accepted, and it must not be converted directly into PRODUCT_NEGATIVE without a post-bound-only measurement.

source_evidence.h4_guard_note: The H4 guard proves that the post-bound source/control interval is discriminative, but it delegates the actual cancel-run terminal classification to the same analyzer and does not remove the bound-straddling cancel window ambiguity.

counterhypothesis.statement: The +window_ms tolerance is merely harmless temporal-resolution slack.
counterhypothesis.reason: Temporal-resolution slack is acceptable only if represented as uncertainty or resolved by a post-bound-only measurement. The canonical benchmark's terminal invariant is no continuing old-packet correlated audio after the declared measured bound; silently widening that bound after execution by one window violates the predeclared-bound contract.

minimal_trigger4_repair.goal: Make the no-post-bound-old-audio test start exactly at the frozen bound in sample space and keep any unresolved boundary overlap fail-closed.
preferred_shape: Compute bound_start_frame = ceil((cancel_offset_ms + max_inflight_ms) * sample_rate / 1000) from the already frozen predeclared bound.

Run a dedicated post-bound correlation scan whose first source frame is bound_start_frame, so every analyzed sample/window belongs entirely to the post-bound interval; do not reuse only windows aligned from cancel_frame.
Require zero old_audio_present in this dedicated post-bound-only scan and preserve the existing H4 requirement that enough source-active/control-correlated material exists there.

Do not use +window_ms as an implicit extension of the declared cancellation bound. If the last-old-audio estimate remains coarser than the bound, report bounded measurement uncertainty or EVIDENCE_INVALID_BOUNDARY_RESOLUTION rather than silently promoting.
Preserve PRODUCT_NEGATIVE only when a post-bound-only window/sample measurement actually observes old-packet correlation after the frozen bound.
required_regressions: Synthetic cancel capture with old-packet correlation present only in the post-bound suffix of a window that starts before the bound must NOT pass.
A straddling analysis window whose post-bound suffix is silent must not be falsely classified PRODUCT_NEGATIVE; dedicated post-bound-only evidence should allow it if all other invariants pass.
Changing --window-ms must not change the semantic bound by granting an extra +window_ms acceptance margin.
Existing H4 discriminative coverage, replacement readback, packet fence, causal delivery, object identity, cleanup scope fences and zero-credit fields remain unchanged.

execution_fence.next_action: Trigger4 folds the boundary-aware post-bound scan into the existing analyzer/guard path together with the already consolidated G2 validity repairs, runs focused regressions, then dispatches one fresh exact repaired S2 subject only if singleton ownership is clear.
